newsitem.title: USA: FGIC says Q3 muni bond insurance volume up 5 pct.
newsitem.headline: FGIC says Q3 muni bond insurance volume up 5 pct.

text.p: Financial Guaranty Insurance Co said Monday it insured $2.975 billion of municipal bonds in the third quarter of 1996, a five percent rise over the $2.832 billion the company insured in the same period last year.
Year to date, FGIC, a unit of GE Capital Services, said it insured $11.809 billion of bonds, a 38 percent rise over the $8.538 billion insured during the first nine months of 1995.
GE Capital is a unit of General Electric Co.

AMBAC Indemnity Corp, a unit of AMBAC Inc, said last week it insured $6.9 billion of municipal bonds in the third quarter and $18.4 billion for the year to date, increases of 41 percent and 60 percent, respectively.
